notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Register entry is the only detailed source; the 1946 photograph record is the only staffing evidence. The WJFW feature covers Wisconsin towers in general and does not name Rock Falls, so its 2015 decommissioning is not applied here. No source on current access, condition or climbing; the record keeps access unknown. The Register's 100-foot figure is the tower's stated height, not measured to the cab floor, so it is not in height_m. Record location, elevation (508 m), county and agency agree with the sources. No corrections proposed. The Forest Lookouts Rock Falls page has a header and navigation only. No new photos with image URLs were found; the photograph record is cited as a source, not as an image.
